question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I take my _____ off to our freedom fighters for their service to our country.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**hat**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The phrase "**take my hat off to**" is an idiom that means to show respect or admiration for someone. (किसी के प्रति सम्मान या प्रशंसा प्रकट करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I have to take my hat off to Sarah for completing the marathon despite facing numerous challenges and never giving up.*
 
 
 
• The sentence expresses admiration for freedom fighters and their service to the country.
 
• The word "**take**" is a verb that needs an object (in this case, "hat").
 
• The word "**off**" is a preposition that shows the direction of the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence**: *I take my hat __off to our freedom fighters for their service to our country.*
